shortDescription: Stacked z-levels as ONE BIG MAP. Pass 41: cross-level hauling rebuilt on ColumnStorage (mod-safe vanilla search per level, no swaps/cache). DOCTRINE B (consumables follow storage, fetched at use time): fixed the diagnosed root cause - the delivered-here anti-carousel pin was trapping relayed food/medicine on the intermediate level. Relay now continues directly past the pin, and the pin only holds items that actually landed in storage; active work (bills/surgery/immobile consumers) still retained.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE
isolated=true always. Companions: **always `astryl.ModernDevTools`**; **NOT Melee Animation**; add `Mehni.PickUpAndHaul` for bulk. Build a column via "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement" (pin may log "Could not find node..." - run manually). Diagnostic: **"AB: explain haul decision"** (ToolMap) - click an item, logs the full decision incl. `exportAllowed=X [importPinned= deliveredHere= nativeNeedPin=]`.

## PASS 41 — COLUMN STORAGE INDEX + DOCTRINE B (consumables)
**CORE:** `StoreUtility.TryFindBestBetterStorageFor(item, carrier:null, map, ...)` runs vanilla's full storage search with NO reachability/virtual-swap and is Harmony-patched by LWM Deep Storage / Adaptive Storage - so modded storage is honored for free and any level is queryable cheaply.
- **`ColumnStorage.cs`:** `TryFindBetter` runs that search on every level, keeps the single best; cross only for a strictly-higher tier on another level (equal/own-level win ties). No swaps, no cache, vanilla-parity perf. `FirstHopToward` + coarse reachability gate.
- **Decisions routed through it:** `TargetLevelFor` storage branch, `CrossLevelHaulJob.Build` (far target -> `AB_HaulChainAcrossLevels` relay hop), all storage givers, and `CrossLevelHaulChain.OnArrive`. Fetch scans in-storage upgrade candidates.
- **DIAGNOSTIC `AB: explain haul decision`** (pass 41) found the real medicine/food bug: `ColumnStorage=cross` but `exportAllowed=False [deliveredHere=True]`.
- **DOCTRINE B (user directive):** consumables (food, medicine, drugs) follow one-big-map STORAGE priority into the best stockpile and are fetched CROSS-LEVEL AT USE TIME (food already has the NeedsPatches cross-level food bridge; surgery/tend medicine via bill-ingredient demand). Only ACTIVE, location-specific work pre-positions/retains a stack: blueprints, live bill/surgery ingredients, refuel, transporter loads, and food for an IMMOBILE consumer (prisoner/bedridden/baby - `AddMealNeeds`, kept). MOBILE pawns register no pull.
- **THE FIX (3 parts):** (1) REVERTED an earlier misdiagnosed `constructionOnly` gate on `ExportAllowed`/`PinnedByNativeNeed` - it would have stripped legitimate bill/surgery retention; the real blocker was never the native-need pin. (2) `CrossLevelHaulChain.OnArrive` now issues the next relay hop DIRECTLY (drop then `AB_HaulChainAcrossLevels` toward the ColumnStorage target), bypassing the DeliveredHere/import pin - a committed relay continuation is not a storage-race bounce, so it must not be trapped on the interchange level. (3) `DeliveredHere` now pins only a stack that actually LANDED IN STORAGE (`t.IsInValidStorage()`); a LOOSE relay-drop or demand delivery stays free to organize onward. Active loose ingredients are still retained by `PinnedByNativeNeed`, not this pin. The race it guards (landing in WORSE storage, re-chasing better) still applies because that stack is in storage.
- **Phase 3/4 (PENDING):** event-driven upgrade driving at scale; work-migration reads ColumnStorage for perf.

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · mech charge · p33 see-below · p36 work priority · p36b aim pose · p40 chunk designation gate · p40 multi-hop relay UPWARD · p40 pull-side fetch.

## Compat
Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream · **LWM Deep Storage + Adaptive Storage Framework (p41: honored via vanilla's patched search)** · DBH/VEF/Rimefeller · Odyssey · Misc. Robots · Allow Tool · CE (p38) · CAI 5000 (p39) · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE
**PASS 41 (TOP) — doctrine B / relay fix (current):**
- FOOD and MEDICINE (loose or in a Normal stockpile) + a Critical stockpile on another level (esp. 2 gaps away, forcing a relay) -> must now ACTUALLY MOVE into Critical and stay. Use `AB: explain haul decision` to confirm (note: for a stack mid-relay on an interchange level, TargetLevelFor may read null because the giver path is pin-gated - the RELAY still moves it via OnArrive; judge by whether items reach the stockpile).
- Immobile-consumer check: a PRISONER (or bedridden patient) still gets food brought to their level (AddMealNeeds retained).
- Regression: chunks cross; equal-tier no-cross; designation gate; downward relay no stall/bounce; PUAH no loop; bill/surgery ingredient still supplied cross-level.

## Status
2026-07-26 (pass 41, BUILT GREEN 0/0): the `AB: explain haul decision` diagnostic pinpointed that food/medicine were blocked by the DeliveredHere anti-carousel pin trapping RELAYED consumables on the intermediate level (not the native-need pin - my earlier constructionOnly change was a misdiagnosis, now reverted). Doctrine B implemented: consumables follow storage + fetch at use time; the relay now continues directly past the pin; DeliveredHere only pins stacks that landed IN storage; active work (bills/surgery/immobile consumers) still retained. Testing ISOLATED + Modern Dev Tools + PUAH.
